criteria.text: Replace Chats/Scheduled Tasks/Background self-improvement popup with compact tabs labeled Chats, Scheduled, Background, directly above the project/sort row; reuse AgentSessionScope and loadSessions unchanged.
Search/sort survive scope changes; project selector remains Chats-only; refresh/sort remain available.
Add a keyboard-operable Sessions disclosure header with visible count. Expanded by default; local transient state only. Collapsing hides session rows/bulk actions but leaves the 280px pane open.
Sessions list is bounded/independently scrollable enough that Tools remains reachable without scrolling through all sessions. Do not make collapse the only route to Tools.
Whole Agents pane 48px collapse remains independent.

Replace active/child/resumable/archived session cards with compact borderless text rows: desktop target 32–36px parent and 28–32px child where practical; transparent default; subtle hover; restrained selected highlight; no persistent border/shadow/card fill.
Preserve status, icons, worktree glyph, titles, menus, archive/resume, multi-select, parent/subagent expand/collapse, collapse-all, creation/loading/error/empty states, and selected-session behavior.
Add visible keyboard focus and selected/expanded semantics; status must have a semantic label, not color alone.

Populate collapsed 48px Agents rail with: Expand, New Session, Sessions shortcut, Tools shortcut, bottom Agent settings. Each has tooltip/semantic label; Tools expands and reveals/focuses Tools; avoid global Settings duplication.
No controller/provider/API/persistence/dependency changes unless truly unavoidable; if discovered, return NEEDS_CONTEXT before expanding ownership.
criteria.reason: Ownership and diff review verify this constraint.

criteria.text: Scope tabs explicitly announce selected state.
Subagent disclosures announce expanded state and support keyboard activation.
The collapsed Sessions rail shortcut reveals an expanded Sessions region, while Tools remains reachable.
Expanded Agents retains Agent settings but removes duplicate global Settings.
Tools rail shortcut expands/reveals Tools and moves focus to a meaningful labeled Tools heading/control with visible focus treatment.
Interactive child session rows have a 28px minimum height without restoring persistent card border or fill.
